_meta.description: Word puzzles for iPhone & iPad: Wheel, Search, and Chain share one fair par-based score inside eighteen living worlds that react to what you spell. Generated music, Game Center daily leaderboards, fully offline — no ads, no accounts, no data collection.
a-chain-board-of.d4a06d: A Chain board of letter tiles, with the words found so far
a-search-board-with.e69f8f: A Search board, with the world's hidden words listed below it
a-wheel-puzzle-a.2886f6: A Wheel puzzle: a ring of letters filling a mini crossword
a-word-search-with.108338: A word search with a twist: every hidden word belongs to the world you're in. An Ocean board hides ocean words.
are-there-ads-or.cc7da0: Are there ads or in-app purchases?

do-worlds-change-the.4d6bb5: Do worlds change the difficulty or the score?
drag-any-path-through.e30752: Drag any path through neighboring letters and build your own words. The board hides more than you think.
eighteen-worlds-each-with.b47903: Eighteen worlds, each with its own light, tiles and generated music, and ten of them arrive with their seasons. Long words pulse the board, and streaks build the world's energy.
every-puzzle-carries-a.d220ca: Every puzzle carries a computed par, and one formula scores every mode, world and level. The Daily Kern gives everyone the same boards, ranked on Game Center.
every-puzzle-is-generated.dd05ad: Every puzzle is generated with a solver-computed par. Reaching par is worth 10,000 points and finishing faster earns up to 1,000 more, with the identical formula in all three modes. Harder boards allow more time, so no world, level or mode can tilt the leaderboard.
how-does-the-fair.50b7f0: How does the fair score work?
is-kern-available-in.54bbc3: Is Kern available in the European Union?
it-s-generated-on.879df5: It's generated on your device — there are no looping tracks. Each world has a recipe (scale, tempo, instruments), your letter selections walk up the scale, and a valid word resolves a chord sized by its length. It honors the silent switch, and you can mix with your own audio from Settings.
kerning-is-the-typographer.0759ec: Kerning is the typographer's craft of adjusting the space between letter pairs until a word sits perfectly — the most obsessive, invisible detail in type. A word game named Kern promises letter-level care. And if you squeeze the r and n too close together, "kerning" reads as "keming" — which is why playing a word with r-n in it earns an achievement by that name.
no-accounts-no-analytics.268b6d: No accounts. No analytics. No third-party SDKs. Nothing leaves your device except the scores you choose to post.
no-ads-ever-no.0b80f6: No ads, ever. No subscriptions, no accounts, no tracking — one price, the whole game.
no-reactivity-is-cosmetic.173b6d: No — reactivity is cosmetic by law. Worlds change the light, the tiles, the music, and the flourishes, never the formula. Finding a word that belongs to a world feeds achievements and your per-world journal, not your score.
no-to-both-kern.ebd1db: No to both. Kern is $4.99 once — no ads, no subscriptions, no in-app purchases, no data collection. Seasonal worlds arrive as part of the game, not as events or passes.
one-seeded-puzzle-per.d0c0c7: One seeded puzzle per mode per day, derived from the date itself — so the whole world plays the same boards with no server involved. Your first completion per mode posts to that day's Game Center leaderboards, and free play stays endless alongside it.
pick-a-place-not.91b441: Pick a place, not a palette
swipe-through-a-letter.2f2f6e: Swipe through a letter wheel to spell words that fill a mini crossword. Extra words bank as bonus finds.

yes-kern-is-on.6d0520: Yes. Kern is on the App Store everywhere in the European Union, France included. It's available in every App Store territory Apple offers except mainland China and Vietnam, where games need a local distribution license I don't hold.
